name: Bad Pun Dog
look: Three photos stacked vertically of a gray and white husky lying on a bed with a gray plush toy. Top: it looks calmly at the camera. Middle: it starts to grin. Bottom: a close-up of it laughing with its mouth wide open.
use: A three-step pun delivery. The first panel sets up a question or innocent statement, the second builds anticipation, and the third lands a groan-worthy pun while the husky cracks up at its own joke.
examples: Why did my wifi and I break up?
My vacuum cleaner quit on me
describe: husky dog laughing with a stuffed toy in three panels
grey and white husky grinning more and more on a bed
dog telling a joke and cracking up at the end
smiling husky holding a plush animal
three pictures of a happy husky with its mouth open
